seoTitle: Semver Range Intersection Calculator for npm
metaDescription: Find the versions that satisfy two npm semver ranges at once, or learn that they conflict. Useful for peer dependency problems.
intro: Combine two version ranges such as ^1.2.0 and >=1.4.0 <3.5.0 into the exact range that satisfies both.
why:
Each range is converted to a set of intervals (caret, tilde, x-ranges, hyphen ranges, comparators and || unions are supported) and the intervals are intersected. The result is shown in comparator form, or a note that no version satisfies both. The implementation was compared with the npm semver package over more than 100,000 range-pair and version checks.

Pre-release tags follow npm's special matching rules that this tool does not model; it works on release versions.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter range A and range B.
Use the intersection to pick a compatible version.
If it is empty, one package must change its requirement.

faq.a: Any version inside it satisfies both of your ranges.

faq.q: What if the result is empty?
faq.a: The requirements cannot be met by one installed version; npm may install two copies or report a conflict.
